footnotes.html: An atomic term symbol's subscript is $J$ itself, not $2J + 1$: the symbol is $^{2S+1}L_J$. A molecular term symbol keeps a subscript as well, $\Omega$, the projection of the total angular momentum on the internuclear axis (Section 9.14).
